disc.name: Floppy disc
disc.desc: A 3.5-inch floppy. Whatever is on it needs a computer to read.

pack.name: Canvas pack
pack.desc: Waxed canvas on two straps. Worn on your back at night: what fits in it is what comes home.

print.name: Printed page
print.desc: A sheet off the printer, its tractor holes still down the sides.

picture.name: Print
picture.desc: A picture printed on fanfold paper, sixteen colours of dots. Someone will pin it to a wall.

sealer.name: Tape gun
sealer.desc: Brown tape on a pistol grip. Drop it on a box to tape it shut; only a knife opens it again.

box_l.name: Large box
box_l.desc: A reinforced crate, 4 by 4, for a big order. Pack it with the slip, tape it, dock it.

sealed.name: Sealed large box
sealed.desc: Taped shut. Nothing goes in or out until a knife cuts the tape. In the dock, with its slip inside, it ships tonight.

box_m.name: Medium box
box_m.desc: Taped fibreboard, 3 by 2: the usual size for an order of a few things. Pack it with the slip, tape it, dock it.

sealed.name: Sealed medium box
sealed.desc: Taped shut. Nothing goes in or out until a knife cuts the tape. In the dock, with its slip inside, it ships tonight.

box_s.name: Small box
box_s.desc: Flat-pack fibreboard, 2 by 2. Pack an order in it with its slip, tape it shut, and put it in the dock: it ships at night.

sealed.name: Sealed small box
sealed.desc: Taped shut. Nothing goes in or out until a knife cuts the tape. In the dock, with its slip inside, it ships tonight.

disc_fab_bp_hardware.name: Hardware blueprints
disc_fab_bp_hardware.desc: Blue-labelled floppy of stamped plans: bolts, rivets, hinges, pipe thread, tins and crates.

disc_fab_bp_heavy.name: Heavy fab blueprints
disc_fab_bp_heavy.desc: Card of structural plans in company grey: hull plate, beams, frames. Stamped CONCERN USE.

disc_fab_bp_precision.name: Precision blueprints
disc_fab_bp_precision.desc: Memory card of tolerance files: bearings, valves, seals, matched spares and the fine tools.

disc_fab_bp_spares.name: Spares blueprints
disc_fab_bp_spares.desc: Floppy labelled in marker: spare parts, brackets, springs, gears and device housings.

disc_fab_bp_tools.name: Hand tool blueprints
disc_fab_bp_tools.desc: Floppy with a greasy thumbprint on the label. Knife, wrench, pliers and cutters, forged to size.

disc_fab_model_fittings.name: Fitting models
disc_fab_model_fittings.desc: Card of printable models: clips, brackets, pipe elbows and device cases.

disc_fab_refine.name: Refinery profiles
disc_fab_refine.desc: Licensed card of recovery profiles: rare earths and noble metal from boards, chips and e-waste.

disc_fab_synth_polymer.name: Polymer synthesis
disc_fab_synth_polymer.desc: Card of chain-growth profiles: carbon and gas into new polymer flake. Warm in the sleeve.

disc_food_bio_cultures.name: Bio cultures
disc_food_bio_cultures.desc: Culture mats and steak, grown from sludge and starter in the bioreactor tank.

disc_food_hydro_greens.name: Hydro greens
disc_food_hydro_greens.desc: Grow charts for leaves, beans, potatoes, herbs and tomatoes on a tray or a rack.

disc_food_hydro_orchard.name: Hydro orchard
disc_food_hydro_orchard.desc: Dwarf stock for the rack: apples, citrus and berries, grown the real way.

disc_food_vat_bakery.name: Vat bakery
disc_food_vat_bakery.desc: Loaves and crackers, with notes on the yeast.

disc_food_vat_charcuterie.name: Vat charcuterie
disc_food_vat_charcuterie.desc: Salami and sausage cured overnight in the vat.

disc_food_vat_dairy.name: Vat dairy
disc_food_vat_dairy.desc: Cheese wheels and spreads from sugar and a sour culture.

disc_food_vat_gourmet.name: Vat gourmet
disc_food_vat_gourmet.desc: Ring-grade terrine, herb cheese and jelly for the industrial vat.

disc_food_vat_staples.name: Vat staples
disc_food_vat_staples.desc: Ration bars, paste tubes, protein blocks, sugar, oil, yeast, and the SYNTH-AG apple.

disc_life_algae_strains.name: Algae strains
disc_life_algae_strains.desc: Scratched floppy from the lung halls: a dense strain and a salt-eating one for the tank.

disc_life_scrubber_profiles.name: Scrubber profiles
disc_life_scrubber_profiles.desc: Gas-sorting tables on a grey floppy: deep strip, puck regeneration, oxygen candle sintering.

disc_lux_bp_fire.name: Fire blueprints
disc_lux_bp_fire.desc: A scratched floppy with no label but a flame drawn on it in marker. Candles, matches, lighters, lamps.

disc_lux_garments.name: Garments
disc_lux_garments.desc: Patterns for overalls, gloves, coats, blankets and curtains, in cut lines and seam counts.

disc_lux_jewellery.name: Jewellery
disc_lux_jewellery.desc: A card of settings, link gauges and casting loads for rings, chains and lockets.

disc_lux_model_art.name: Model art
disc_lux_model_art.desc: A card of polygon models: figures, scrolls and ornaments sized for the large printer.

disc_lux_perfumery.name: Perfumery
disc_lux_perfumery.desc: Distillation notes for scents, soaps and pastes, with ring-grade proportions marked in red.

disc_lux_vintner.name: Vintner
disc_lux_vintner.desc: A floppy of cellar tables: must ratios, bottling times, how long a still may run before the cap sweats.

disc_mach_bp_filters.name: Filter blueprints
disc_mach_bp_filters.desc: Moulds and sleeve drawings for water filters and air cartridges. Spine bunks live off the prints.

disc_mach_bp_machines_1.name: Machine blueprints I
disc_mach_bp_machines_1.desc: Drawings for the first machines: bench, smelter, charger, sealer. Cut the parts; the fabricator does the rest.

disc_mach_bp_machines_2.name: Machine blueprints II
disc_mach_bp_machines_2.desc: Close-tolerance drawings for fabricators, kilns, scrubbers and chillers. Needs a precision bed to hold them.

disc_mach_bp_machines_3.name: Machine blueprints III
disc_mach_bp_machines_3.desc: A card of assembly plates for the big machines: precision cabinet, annealer drum. Autofab or nothing.

disc_mach_consumables.name: Consumable recipes
disc_mach_consumables.desc: A chemist's sheet in pencil: coolant, lubricant, sealant, with the ratios crossed out and redone.

disc_mach_labels_company.name: Company label set
disc_mach_labels_company.desc: The licence mark and batch numbers the company puts on its own stock. Honest copies are rare.

disc_mach_labels_ring.name: Ring label set
disc_mach_labels_ring.desc: A grade stamp and a script font lifted from a Ring catalogue. Goods wearing it fetch more on the hoop.

disc_med_analgesics.name: Analgesics
disc_med_analgesics.desc: Dosage tables and die settings for painkillers and burn tabs. Every clinic copy has coffee on it.

disc_med_antibiotics.name: Antibiotics
disc_med_antibiotics.desc: Synthesis card for antibiotics and antivirals. Stamped by a ring pharmacy; copy-protected.

disc_med_chem_basics.name: Chem basics
disc_med_chem_basics.desc: Floppy of the bench primer: purifying, ethanol, antiseptic, acids and bases, by the numbers.

disc_med_narcotics.name: Narcotics
disc_med_narcotics.desc: Unmarked floppy, handwritten label peeled half off. Dream tabs and ampoules, bench and reactor settings.

disc_med_regenerative.name: Regenerative
disc_med_regenerative.desc: Ring medicine card: regrowth gel and gene patch cultures. Heavy, real and licensed.

disc_med_sedatives.name: Sedatives
disc_med_sedatives.desc: Press settings for sleeping pills and calmers, with a dosage warning typed in capitals.

disc_med_stimulants.name: Stimulants
disc_med_stimulants.desc: Bench sheets for stims and energy tabs. The last page is a list of known side effects.

disc_tech_blank_card.name: Blank card
disc_tech_blank_card.desc: A memory card the size of a stamp, gold contacts and no label. Takes a model or a program.

disc_tech_blank_floppy.name: Blank floppy
disc_tech_blank_floppy.desc: A 3.5-inch floppy with a white label and nothing on it. Whatever you copy to it needs a terminal to read.

disc_tech_bp_automata.name: Automata blueprints
disc_tech_bp_automata.desc: Heavy card of drone frames and loader arms, stamped CONCERN ONLY in red.

disc_tech_bp_cells.name: Cell chemistry
disc_tech_bp_cells.desc: A company card of electrode ratios and sleeve drawings. The copier refuses it; the cell press does not.

disc_tech_bp_circuits.name: Circuit blueprints
disc_tech_bp_circuits.desc: Floppy of etched traces for boards, cables, sensors, motors and relays. Hand-numbered, lamp-black label.

disc_tech_bp_computers.name: Computer blueprints
disc_tech_bp_computers.desc: Card of board layouts, chip masks and chassis for terminals, laptops and desk units.

disc_tech_bp_devices.name: Device blueprints
disc_tech_bp_devices.desc: Card of assembly drawings for handsets, radios, heaters, fans, clocks, locks and alarms.

disc_tech_bp_lamps.name: Lamp blueprints
disc_tech_bp_lamps.desc: Yellow-sleeved floppy of tube and base drawings: grow lamps, work lights and the plain torch.

disc_tech_data_lore.name: Salvaged disc
disc_tech_data_lore.desc: An unlabelled disc with a sticking shutter. Diaries, logs and schedules from somebody else's life.

disc_tech_model_gadgets.name: Gadget models
disc_tech_model_gadgets.desc: Card of printable 3D models: shells, cases, key fobs and the odd plastic gadget.

disc_tech_prog_antivirus.name: Scrub disc
disc_tech_prog_antivirus.desc: A white-labelled disc with a stamp: CLEAN. Finds what rode in on a copy and strips it.

disc_tech_prog_automate.name: Automation card
disc_tech_prog_automate.desc: A card of scripts that load and start machine jobs in the night. Saves a morning of energy.

disc_tech_prog_blackmarket.name: Night client
disc_tech_prog_blackmarket.desc: Encrypted client for the black-market order board. The label is blank and the plastic is warm.

disc_tech_prog_board.name: Price board disc
disc_tech_prog_board.desc: Live need prices and trend arrows, drawn in green on the terminal screen.

disc_tech_prog_cracker.name: Cracker disc
disc_tech_prog_cracker.desc: A hand-labelled disc with no brand and a skull drawn in biro. It patches licence checks out of anything.

disc_tech_prog_diagnostics.name: Diagnostics disc
disc_tech_prog_diagnostics.desc: Polls every machine on the field and lists what is jammed, hot or unplugged.

disc_tech_prog_dockmaster.name: Dock manifest disc
disc_tech_prog_dockmaster.desc: Manifest disc issued with the dock gantry: what ships, which box, what each one pays.

disc_tech_prog_forecast.name: Forecast card
disc_tech_prog_forecast.desc: A licensed card that reads the engineers' bands and the board together. Wants a dongle in the port bay.

disc_tech_prog_labels.name: Labels disc
disc_tech_prog_labels.desc: Prints order slips and shelf labels on the slip printer. Dot-matrix font, three sizes.

disc_tech_prog_ledger.name: Ledger disc
disc_tech_prog_ledger.desc: A day-book program: what sold, what moved, what the station did. Reads like a diary of numbers.

disc_tech_prog_mail.name: Mail client
disc_tech_prog_mail.desc: The company's mail disc: orders, attachments and the daily memo. No modem, no mail.

disc_tech_prog_mines.name: Mines
disc_tech_prog_mines.desc: A grey disc, ten kilobytes of dread. Flag the mines. Do not step on the mines.

disc_tech_prog_modelstore.name: Model store card
disc_tech_prog_modelstore.desc: Licensed shop client for 3D models: pick one, pay, and it is written to a blank card.

disc_tech_prog_music.name: Tracker and chess
disc_tech_prog_music.desc: A scuffed disc of module tunes and a chess board. Somebody scratched a clef into the plastic.

disc_tech_prog_overclock.name: Overclock disc
disc_tech_prog_overclock.desc: A scorched-edge disc of timing tables. Machines go faster; so do their jams.

disc_tech_prog_paint.name: Pixel paint
disc_tech_prog_paint.desc: An orange shareware disc with a brush and a little sun on a hand-drawn label. Copy me, it says.

disc_tech_prog_stock.name: Stocktake Pro
disc_tech_prog_stock.desc: A green disc in a hard case with a hologram sticker. The case says LICENSED SOFTWARE.

disc_tech_prog_utilities.name: Utility disc
disc_tech_prog_utilities.desc: Three small programs on one disc: a defragmenter, a mail cipher and a bench tuner.

disc_tech_prog_wholesale.name: Wholesale client
disc_tech_prog_wholesale.desc: Account disc for the company trade desk: crates at market price, one account number.

it_core_biomass_paste.name: Biomass paste
it_core_biomass_paste.desc: A grey brick of pressed paste, cold and faintly sweet. What the vats are fed.

it_core_carbon_dust.name: Carbon dust
it_core_carbon_dust.desc: Black dust that coats the hand and stays. Out of old filters, burnt husks and duct soot.

it_core_cell_husk.name: Dead cell husk
it_core_cell_husk.desc: A drained cell casing, split down the seam. A little lithium still clings to the inside.

it_core_dead_appliance.name: Dead appliance
it_core_dead_appliance.desc: A kettle, a fan or a heater-plate gone black. Heavy for what it is, worth taking apart.

it_core_duct_junk.name: Duct junk
it_core_duct_junk.desc: A tangle of foil tape, fan housings and ducting yanked from the spine walls.

it_core_ewaste.name: E-waste
it_core_ewaste.desc: A stack of dead boards and cracked screens. Worth more crushed than whole.

it_core_fibre_lint.name: Fibre lint
it_core_fibre_lint.desc: A grey wad of lint and short fibre pulled from filters and bedding. Soft, dusty, useful.

it_core_filter_husks.name: Spent filters
it_core_filter_husks.desc: Clogged cartridge husks from the scrubber bank, black inside and smelling of old breath.

it_core_gas_bladder.name: Gas bladder
it_core_gas_bladder.desc: A tight, flat bladder of mixed gas, strapped to a carry-frame. Handle with care; do not puncture.

it_core_greywater.name: Greywater
it_core_greywater.desc: A sealed flask of cloudy water. Not for drinking until it has been through a purifier.

it_core_grit.name: Grit
it_core_grit.desc: Coarse pale sand ground from stone and old glass. Scours, fills, and melts into glass.

it_core_hull_offcuts.name: Hull offcuts
it_core_hull_offcuts.desc: Heavy plates and strips of hull alloy, cut off during repair and left on the dock.

it_core_ice.name: Ice block
it_core_ice.desc: A dirty block of comet ice, grey with dust and hard to hold. Water and gas, once it melts.

it_core_lithium_salt.name: Lithium salt
it_core_lithium_salt.desc: White, caking salt in a screw-top tub. It holds a charge the way nothing else does.

it_core_noble_flake.name: Noble flake
it_core_noble_flake.desc: A pinch of gold-bright flakes in a sealed twist of foil. It never tarnishes.

it_core_ore_copper.name: Copper ore
it_core_ore_copper.desc: Grey rock with green crusts of malachite and specks of copper. Two lumps make a bar.

it_core_ore_iron.name: Iron ore
it_core_ore_iron.desc: Heavy red-brown rock, banded with rust and glinting where it broke. Two lumps make a bar.

it_core_ore_light.name: Bauxite
it_core_ore_light.desc: Pitted red-brown bauxite, light for its size. The only source of fresh light metal.

it_core_polymer_flake.name: Polymer flake
it_core_polymer_flake.desc: Grey chips of crushed plastic, bagged. Warm to the touch when fresh. Becomes sheet and casing.

it_core_rags.name: Rags
it_core_rags.desc: A tied bundle of stained cloth off the spine bunks. Fibre for the pulper, and not much else.

it_core_rare_dust.name: Rare dust
it_core_rare_dust.desc: Grey, greasy dust that clings to the fingers. The magnets and chips are made of this.

it_core_reagent_dregs.name: Reagent dregs
it_core_reagent_dregs.desc: Dark, mixed chemical dregs in a stoppered vial. A chemist can work with it. Nobody else should.

it_core_rubble.name: Rubble
it_core_rubble.desc: A heavy bag of broken panel, concrete grit and old filter fill, swept from the dock floor.

it_core_salt_cake.name: Salt cake
it_core_salt_cake.desc: A pale crust of mineral salt, scraped off the reclaim tanks and pressed into a cake.

it_core_salvage_crate.name: Salvage crate
it_core_salvage_crate.desc: A battered lidded crate from a clearance sale, packed with whatever a scavenger could not sell.

it_core_scrap_copper.name: Copper scrap
it_core_scrap_copper.desc: Stripped copper, still curled from the conduit it came out of. One unit of copper.

it_core_scrap_iron.name: Iron scrap
it_core_scrap_iron.desc: A fist of bent iron offcuts, rust-red where the paint has gone. One unit of iron.

it_core_scrap_light.name: Light scrap
it_core_scrap_light.desc: Pale alloy bent off a ladder rail or a duct frame. Light enough for one hand.

it_core_scrap_mixed.name: Mixed scrap
it_core_scrap_mixed.desc: A lot of junk bagged together: bent iron, plastic housings, a few lengths of wire. Crush or recycle it.

it_core_slag.name: Slag
it_core_slag.desc: Glassy grey clinker raked out of the smelter. The kiln can use it.

it_core_sludge.name: Sludge
it_core_sludge.desc: A sealed jug of brown slurry that is all that remains of other things. Digest it or vent it.

it_core_wire_tangle.name: Wire tangle
it_core_wire_tangle.desc: A knotted ball of cable, half stripped, with a few cracked connectors still hanging off.

it_fab_bar_copper.name: Copper ingot
it_fab_bar_copper.desc: A bar of copper, cast in a mould: a little hollow on top where it cooled.

it_fab_bar_iron.name: Iron ingot
it_fab_bar_iron.desc: A bar of iron, cast in a mould: a little hollow on top where it cooled.

it_fab_bar_light.name: Light-metal bar
it_fab_bar_light.desc: Pale bar with a frosted skin, light for its size. Housings and ring plate start here.

it_fab_bar_noble.name: Noble bar
it_fab_bar_noble.desc: A small heavy bar, warm to the hand. Jewellers and chip lines count them one by one.

it_fab_beam.name: Structural beam
it_fab_beam.desc: A rolled I-beam, four hands long, painted deck-grey. Frames, racks and gantries.

it_fab_bearing.name: Bearing
it_fab_bearing.desc: A sealed ball bearing in a greased race. Spins for years, then all at once does not.

it_fab_bottle.name: Bottle
it_fab_bottle.desc: Clear glass and a cork: you can see exactly what is in it.

it_fab_bracket.name: Bracket
it_fab_bracket.desc: An L of bent steel with two slots. Holds shelves, pipes and cables to the wall.

it_fab_crate.name: Polymer crate
it_fab_crate.desc: A ribbed polymer crate with handholds. Stacks, rinses clean and outlives its contents.

it_fab_crucible_liner.name: Crucible liner
it_fab_crucible_liner.desc: A fired ceramic cup with a carbon skin. Takes the heat so the smelter does not. Wears.

it_fab_cutter.name: Cutters
it_fab_cutter.desc: Long-handled shears with a compound hinge. Takes bolts, rivets and strip. Wears.

it_fab_fasteners.name: Fasteners
it_fab_fasteners.desc: A tin of bolts and rivets, sorted by feel. Never enough of them.

it_fab_gear.name: Gear
it_fab_gear.desc: A cut steel gear with a keyed bore. Small, heavy, and exact about its teeth.

it_fab_glass_pane.name: Glass pane
it_fab_glass_pane.desc: Kiln glass, slightly green, with a bubble or two. Cuts to a lens or a window.

it_fab_hinge.name: Hinge
it_fab_hinge.desc: Two leaves and a pin. Doors, lids and cabinets on every deck swing on these.

it_fab_housing.name: Device housing
it_fab_housing.desc: A pale metal shell with screw posts and a polymer lid. Tech builds its devices inside.

it_fab_hull_plate.name: Hull plate
it_fab_hull_plate.desc: Layered steel and light-metal plate, hand-sized stencils on one edge. Spans a breach.

it_fab_jar.name: Glass jar
it_fab_jar.desc: Wide-mouthed jar with a screw neck. Preserves, tablets, a few hundred grams of anything.

it_fab_knife.name: Kitchen knife
it_fab_knife.desc: Your first tool. Drop it on cheese or ham to cut a piece off.

it_fab_lens.name: Glass lens
it_fab_lens.desc: A small ground disc, clear at the middle. Lamps, scopes and loupes all want one.

it_fab_light_sheet.name: Light-metal sheet
it_fab_light_sheet.desc: Pale sheet rolled from a light bar, soft enough to cut with shears.

it_fab_loupe.name: Loupe
it_fab_loupe.desc: A ground lens in a steel collar on a short stem. Reads chip pins and flaws in a bar. Wears.

it_fab_multitool.name: Multitool
it_fab_multitool.desc: Fold-out jaws, blade, driver and file in one steel body. A fitter keeps it on a lanyard. Wears.

it_fab_pipe.name: Pipe
it_fab_pipe.desc: A length of steel pipe, threaded at both ends. Water, gas and coolant all run in it.

it_fab_pliers.name: Pliers
it_fab_pliers.desc: Flat jaws, a wire cutter, and polymer grips worn smooth. Bends what the hand cannot. Wears.

it_fab_polymer_film.name: Polymer film
it_fab_polymer_film.desc: Thin clear film in a roll. Wraps, covers and seals what a box will not.

it_fab_polymer_sheet.name: Polymer sheet
it_fab_polymer_sheet.desc: Grey polymer pressed flat, warm from the extruder. Housings, tubs and patches.

it_fab_polymer_tube.name: Polymer tube
it_fab_polymer_tube.desc: Grey flexible tube, a metre long. Drips, drains and cable runs.

it_fab_print_bracket.name: Printed bracket
it_fab_print_bracket.desc: A light bracket of polymer with a metal core, ribbed where it will take load.

it_fab_print_clip.name: Printed clip
it_fab_print_clip.desc: A polymer snap clip, printed layer by layer. Cable, tube and panel.

it_fab_print_fitting.name: Printed fitting
it_fab_print_fitting.desc: An elbow or tee for a pipe run, printed in one piece. No seam to leak at.

it_fab_rare_ingot.name: Rare-earth ingot
it_fab_rare_ingot.desc: A dull dark ingot, brittle and heavy for its size. Magnets, chips and lamps start here.

it_fab_seal.name: Seal
it_fab_seal.desc: A ring of grey polymer that keeps a line from weeping. Cut to a tolerance.

it_fab_sheet.name: Steel sheet
it_fab_sheet.desc: Rolled thin from a bar, edges still sharp. Two to a bar.

it_fab_spare_part.name: Spare part
it_fab_spare_part.desc: The generic part the station runs on: a cast body, a bush, a gasket. Fits most things badly.

it_fab_spare_patched.name: Patched spare
it_fab_spare_patched.desc: A spare part welded from two broken ones and a prayer. Spine fixers swear by it.

it_fab_spare_precision.name: Precision spare
it_fab_spare_precision.desc: Matched spring, gear, bearing and seal in a sealed sleeve. Ground to tolerance, ring-grade.

it_fab_spring.name: Spring
it_fab_spring.desc: Coiled wire in a short cylinder. Every latch, valve and trigger wants one.

it_fab_tile.name: Ceramic tile
it_fab_tile.desc: Fired grey tile, glazed on one side. Floors, benches and furnace walls.

it_fab_tin.name: Tin can
it_fab_tin.desc: Empty can and lid, rolled and crimped. Food goes in, and stays in.

it_fab_torque_driver.name: Torque driver
it_fab_torque_driver.desc: A clicking driver set to a number on its collar. Tightens to the spec and no further. Wears.

it_fab_tub.name: Polymer tub
it_fab_tub.desc: A squat tub with a snap lid. Holds paste, salve or a day of screws.

it_fab_valve.name: Valve
it_fab_valve.desc: A brass-seated valve with a hand wheel, for water and gas lines.

it_fab_vial.name: Glass vial
it_fab_vial.desc: Empty stoppered glass tube. The clinic and the cellar both fill these.

it_fab_wire.name: Copper wire
it_fab_wire.desc: A coil of bare copper, a few metres. Four to a bar.

it_fab_wrench.name: Wrench
it_fab_wrench.desc: A forged open jaw on a short arm. In your hand at night it takes bolted panels off. Wears a little every night out.

it_fit_ad_board.name: Ad board
it_fit_ad_board.desc: A hung board with a changing strip: one need advertised at a time, to everyone walking past.

it_fit_aerial.name: Roof aerial
it_fit_aerial.desc: A light-metal mast through the ceiling tiles on a coax run. Engineers' chatter comes in clear.

it_fit_berth.name: Crew berth
it_fit_berth.desc: Light-metal berth with a foam pad, a reading lamp and a door that latches from inside.

it_fit_bookshelf.name: Bookshelf
it_fit_bookshelf.desc: Two plain wooden shelves. Books stand where you put them, spines out.

it_fit_bunk.name: Bunk
it_fit_bunk.desc: Welded frame, a locker under the mattress, a curtain on a wire. A spine bed, kept clean.

it_fit_cabin.name: Ring cabin
it_fit_cabin.desc: A sleeping cabin in ring-grade veneer, a real window, quiet air. Nothing in it is recycled.

it_fit_cabinet.name: Steel cabinet
it_fit_cabinet.desc: Steel, a roller grate and a ring pull. Holds a lot more than it looks.

it_fit_cell_bank.name: Cell bank
it_fit_cell_bank.desc: A racked frame with six cradles. Cells sit in it between jobs and take on a little more.

it_fit_cold_cabinet.name: Cold cabinet
it_fit_cold_cabinet.desc: A chilled glass-door cabinet running off a cell. Cheese, salami and fresh greens keep and sell.

it_fit_cot.name: Folding cot
it_fit_cot.desc: Canvas on a steel frame, set up behind the stock. Sleep on it and the morning has more in it.

it_fit_counter_2.name: Second counter
it_fit_counter_2.desc: A steel-topped counter, a till and a stool. The queue splits and moves.

it_fit_disc_rack.name: Disc holder
it_fit_disc_rack.desc: A tower of shallow black plastic shelves. The discs lie flat, so eight fit, edge out.

it_fit_display_case.name: Display case
it_fit_display_case.desc: Glass-fronted, lit from inside, with a lock nobody uses. Things behind glass are worth more.

it_fit_hand_station.name: Hand station
it_fit_hand_station.desc: A bench, a stool and a locker with a name taped on it. Someone works here while you sleep.

it_fit_ledger_book.name: Ledger book
it_fit_ledger_book.desc: Cloth-bound columns and a pencil on a string. Each evening you write down what sold and why.

it_fit_load_governor.name: Load governor
it_fit_load_governor.desc: A rack unit that staggers every machine start across the grid. Same work, less effort to start it.

it_fit_parts_locker.name: Parts locker
it_fit_parts_locker.desc: Forty labelled bins behind a steel door. Fasteners, bearings and valves, sorted for once.

it_fit_pigeonholes.name: Pigeonholes
it_fit_pigeonholes.desc: A wall of paper slots for slips, notices and standing orders. Senders find a shop that answers.

it_fit_price_board.name: Price board
it_fit_price_board.desc: A wall screen of live need prices and trend arrows, fed from the spine counting house.

it_fit_ring_frontage.name: Ring frontage
it_fit_ring_frontage.desc: Glass shopfront, warm light and a brass rail, on the promenade. The rent is paid in real money.

it_fit_safe.name: Floor safe
it_fit_safe.desc: Bolted steel box with a dial and a heavy door. Cash, discs and heirlooms go in.

it_fit_shelf_unit.name: Shelf unit
it_fit_shelf_unit.desc: Open steel shelving on four legs, bolted down. Holds whatever you stack on it.

it_fit_sign.name: Shop sign
it_fit_sign.desc: Stencilled letters on a lit panel above the shutter. The corridor starts to know the name.

it_fit_strongroom.name: Strongroom
it_fit_strongroom.desc: A plated cell behind the stockroom wall, no sign on the door. Fire, drugs and cracked discs sleep here.

it_fit_vent_hood.name: Extractor hood
it_fit_vent_hood.desc: A ducted hood over the machine row. Less heat and dust in the works, fewer jams.

it_fit_vitrine.name: Locked vitrine
it_fit_vitrine.desc: Tall glass and light-metal, a real lock, a velvet shelf. For anything a collector asks to hold.

it_food_apple.name: Apple
it_food_apple.desc: Grown on a tree somewhere. Bruised, speckled, real.

synthetic.desc: Grown in a vat. Perfectly red, perfectly round, nothing wrong with it at all.

it_food_beans.name: Broad beans
it_food_beans.desc: Fat pods from the hydro tray, shelled by hand. Plain protein that grows.

it_food_berries.name: Berries
it_food_berries.desc: A handful of dark berries in a paper cone. Ring luxury, dear by the handful.

it_food_bread.name: Sliced bread
it_food_bread.desc: Sliced white in cling film, eight slices when new. Double-click it to take a slice out; drop a slice on it to put it back.

it_food_bread_slice.name: Slice of bread
it_food_bread_slice.desc: One slice. Lay cheese or salami on it and it is a sandwich; another slice on top finishes it.

it_food_cheese_herb.name: Herb cheese
it_food_cheese_herb.desc: A soft round cheese folded through with fresh herbs. Ring tables only.

it_food_cheese_spread.name: Cheese spread
it_food_cheese_spread.desc: Pale cheese paste in a tube. Spread it on bread or squeeze it onto a ration bar.

it_food_cheese_wedge.name: Cheddar wedge
it_food_cheese_wedge.desc: An eighth of a wheel: six slices, cut off its thin end with a knife. Its cut end shows the next slice.

it_food_cheese_wheel.name: Cheddar wheel
it_food_cheese_wheel.desc: A whole wheel of cheddar, eight wedges of it. Cut one off with a knife.

it_food_citrus.name: Citrus
it_food_citrus.desc: A yellow fruit with a thick rind and a real scent. The ring sells it by the piece.

it_food_coffee.name: Coffee brick
it_food_coffee.desc: A vacuum brick of ground coffee from real ring beans. The smell alone could start a riot on the spine.

it_food_crackers.name: Crackers
it_food_crackers.desc: A foil pack of dry vat crackers, salted on one side. They keep.

it_food_culture_mat.name: Culture mat
it_food_culture_mat.desc: A dense wet mat grown from sludge in the bioreactor tank. Fibrous, faintly sweet, edible.

it_food_culture_steak.name: Culture steak
it_food_culture_steak.desc: Cultured protein, grained and seared like meat. The Concern's answer to the ring's table.

it_food_dumplings.name: Dumpling
it_food_dumplings.desc: A fried dumpling stuffed with herbs and paste. Greasy, filling, favoured on the Dock.

it_food_fruit_jelly.name: Fruit jelly
it_food_fruit_jelly.desc: Berry jelly set in a glass jar, red as a warning light. A ring gift.

it_food_greens.name: Salad greens
it_food_greens.desc: Pale leaves grown under a lamp. Limp and bitter, and the nearest thing the spine has to a garden.

it_food_herbs.name: Herb bunch
it_food_herbs.desc: A tied bunch of green herbs. The smell alone is worth a few credits on the spine.

it_food_noodles.name: Noodle bowl
it_food_noodles.desc: Paste noodles in stock, with a pinch of salt. Steams for a minute and is gone.

it_food_oil.name: Plant oil
it_food_oil.desc: Pale pressed oil in a plastic flask. For frying, for salves, and for hinges that squeal.

it_food_paste_tube.name: Paste tube
it_food_paste_tube.desc: Brown paste in a squeeze tube. Eaten straight from the nozzle on the long shifts.

it_food_porridge.name: Porridge pot
it_food_porridge.desc: Warm paste and water stirred smooth in a tin pot. Breakfast on every deck below the ring.

it_food_potatoes.name: Potatoes
it_food_potatoes.desc: Knobbly tubers in a mesh sack, still faintly damp. Cook them or press them for sugar.

it_food_protein_block.name: Protein block
it_food_protein_block.desc: A dense salted block of pressed paste. Chewy, grey, and the works canteen's lunch.

it_food_ration_bar.name: Ration bar
it_food_ration_bar.desc: Grey paste pressed into a bar. Tastes of nothing. Keeps a body going.

it_food_ring_dinner.name: Ring dinner
it_food_ring_dinner.desc: Terrine, apple and citrus plated for the ring. Real, clean, and priced like it.

it_food_salami.name: Salami
it_food_salami.desc: A cured salami, tied with string, dusted white. Eight slices of it; cut them with a knife. Its cut end shows the next slice.

it_food_salami_slice.name: Slice of salami
it_food_salami_slice.desc: Deep red, flecked with fat, a darker rim of casing. No two slices are the same.

it_food_sandwich.name: Sandwich
it_food_sandwich.desc: Bread and what was laid on it, worth more than its makings: a fifth more open, half again once a second slice finishes it. Finished, it stays as it is.

it_food_sandwich_cheese.name: Cheese sandwich
it_food_sandwich_cheese.desc: Two slices of vat bread and a slice of cheese. Plain, and good enough.

it_food_sandwich_double.name: Double sandwich
it_food_sandwich_double.desc: Bread, salami and cheese in a stack that will not close. Eat it with both hands.

it_food_sausage.name: Sausage
it_food_sausage.desc: Vat sausage in a plastic casing, a chain of four. Fatty, peppery and unmistakeably grey.

it_food_seed_apple.name: Apple graft
it_food_seed_apple.desc: A dwarf apple graft in a wet sleeve, stamped with a ring nursery mark. Nearly unobtainable.

it_food_seed_beans.name: Bean seed
it_food_seed_beans.desc: Dry broad beans in a twist of paper. Plant them and more beans come back.

it_food_seed_berry.name: Berry cutting
it_food_seed_berry.desc: A bundle of cut canes in damp moss. Ring stock; the thorns are real.

it_food_seed_citrus.name: Citrus graft
it_food_seed_citrus.desc: A bare citrus stem in a wet sleeve, with a ring nursery tag wired round it.

it_food_seed_greens.name: Greens seed
it_food_seed_greens.desc: A paper twist of pale seed, enough for one tray. Comes up in leaf under the lamp.

it_food_seed_herbs.name: Herb seed
it_food_seed_herbs.desc: Fine black seed in a screw of foil. Parsley, mostly, or something near it.

it_food_seed_potato.name: Seed potato
it_food_seed_potato.desc: Wrinkled sprouting tubers the size of thumbs. Cut and set, they take root in a tray.

it_food_seed_tomato.name: Tomato seed
it_food_seed_tomato.desc: Flat yellow seed pressed between two cards. Wants clean water and a good lamp.

it_food_stew.name: Hot stew
it_food_stew.desc: Potatoes and protein in brown broth. The galley's best answer to a long shift.

it_food_stock_cube.name: Stock cube
it_food_stock_cube.desc: A hard grey cube of salt and boiled paste. One dissolves into a pot of broth.

it_food_sugar.name: Sugar
it_food_sugar.desc: White crystals in a twist of foil. Feeds the vat, the still and the galley; children on the spine eat it dry.

it_food_terrine.name: Terrine
it_food_terrine.desc: Vat meat set with herbs and oil in a mould. Served on the ring in thin slices.

it_food_tin_apple.name: Tinned apple
it_food_tin_apple.desc: Apple halves in syrup, sealed in a can. The only fruit most of the spine will ever taste.

it_food_tin_beans.name: Tinned beans
it_food_tin_beans.desc: Broad beans sealed in a can with a little brine. Nothing on the label but a number.

it_food_tin_stew.name: Tinned stew
it_food_tin_stew.desc: Stew sealed hot into a tin. Opens with a knife and tastes of the tin.

it_food_toastie.name: Toasted sandwich
it_food_toastie.desc: A sandwich pressed hot on the galley plate. The salami sweats and the bread finally has a crust.

it_food_tomatoes.name: Tomatoes
it_food_tomatoes.desc: Small hard tomatoes, red on one side. Hydro-grown, so almost real.

it_food_yeast.name: Yeast culture
it_food_yeast.desc: A cloudy grey culture in a stoppered tube. Wakes the bread dough and feeds the still.

it_life_air_puck.name: Air puck
it_life_air_puck.desc: A grey puck of salt and carbon that sits in a bunk vent and softens the air. Spent in a month.

it_life_algae.name: Algae mat
it_life_algae.desc: A wet green mat lifted from the tank, slick and cold. Vat feedstock; it breathes the air clean.

it_life_algae_dense.name: Dense algae
it_life_algae_dense.desc: A pressed block of deep-green algae from a fast strain. Twice the biomass, half the water.

it_life_brine.name: Brine
it_life_brine.desc: Salt water in a stoppered flask, left over from the cooling loops. Undrinkable, useful to a still.

it_life_canister.name: Gas canister
it_life_canister.desc: A steel canister with a screw valve, dented and relabelled. Empty. Fill it, use it, bring it back.

it_life_distilled.name: Distilled water
it_life_distilled.desc: Boiled off and caught again in glass-clear tubing. Flat, pure, no minerals at all.

it_life_foul_air.name: Foul air bladder
it_life_foul_air.desc: A bladder of exhaled air from the bunks, warm and sour. Carbon lives in it. Algae eat it.

it_life_hydrogen.name: Hydrogen canister
it_life_hydrogen.desc: A canister of hydrogen, red band at the neck. Fuel for the reactor crews and the cell shops.

it_life_mask_refill.name: Mask refill
it_life_mask_refill.desc: A thumb-sized cartridge of breathing gas that clips into a mask. Good for a long shift.

it_life_meltwater.name: Meltwater
it_life_meltwater.desc: Ice melted in a bag and strained once. Hard, grey, tastes of iron. Fine for a bunk, better filtered.

it_life_nutrient.name: Nutrient mix
it_life_nutrient.desc: Grey salts with a little paste stirred in, sold in a twist of film. Hydro feed; the trays drink it.

it_life_nutrient_rich.name: Fruiting mix
it_life_nutrient_rich.desc: Nutrient mix with reagent worked in, blue-tinged. For orchards and anything that has to flower.

it_life_oxygen.name: Oxygen canister
it_life_oxygen.desc: A full canister of breathing gas, green band at the neck. Clinic and Works both stock a rack.

it_life_oxygen_candle.name: Oxygen candle
it_life_oxygen_candle.desc: A salt-and-iron block that burns without flame inside its tin and gives off oxygen. For emergencies.

it_life_puck_spent.name: Spent puck
it_life_puck_spent.desc: A bunk air puck gone dark and heavy with breath. The scrubber can wake it again.

it_life_rebreather.name: Sealed rebreather
it_life_rebreather.desc: A full-face mask with its own cartridge, polymer skirt stitched to cloth. Gets you through a leak.

it_life_regulator.name: Gas regulator
it_life_regulator.desc: A valve and a short pipe brazed into a pressure regulator. Hydrogen only goes through one of these.

it_life_saline.name: Saline water
it_life_saline.desc: Distilled water with a measured pinch of salt, bottled for the clinic. Washes wounds, fills drips.

it_life_tester_strip.name: Water tester
it_life_tester_strip.desc: A paper strip that turns from yellow to blue in clean water. Brown means do not drink.

it_life_water.name: Water pouch
it_life_water.desc: A litre of clean water in a heat-sealed polymer pouch, cold to the touch.

it_life_water_bottle.name: Bottled water
it_life_water_bottle.desc: Distilled water in a real glass bottle with a cork. Ring households keep a shelf of these for show.

it_life_water_jug.name: Water jug
it_life_water_jug.desc: Four litres in a sealed polymer jug with a tap. Heavy to carry up a bunk ladder.

it_life_water_ration.name: Water ration
it_life_water_ration.desc: A flat sachet with a day of water in it, stamped with a bunk number. The spine lives on these.

it_lux_banner.name: Cloth banner
it_lux_banner.desc: Printed cloth hung from a pole: a crew colour, a slogan or a name. Spine crews paint their own.

it_lux_beer.name: Algae beer
it_lux_beer.desc: A dented can of green-gold beer brewed from tank algae. Tastes of the tank, works anyway.

it_lux_blanket.name: Blanket
it_lux_blanket.desc: Three bolts of cloth stitched into one. The warmest thing in a four-high bunk.

it_lux_board.name: Pasteboard
it_lux_board.desc: Paper pressed three deep and dried flat. Stiff enough for covers, packing and playing cards.

it_lux_book.name: Book
it_lux_book.desc: Leather-bound, the title worn off. Paper is getting rare.

it_lux_candle.name: Candle
it_lux_candle.desc: A taper of wax and a wick: light when the power is out.

it_lux_cards.name: Playing cards
it_lux_cards.desc: Fifty-two squares of board, soft at the corners. Every spine bunk has a deck.

it_lux_chain.name: Gold chain
it_lux_chain.desc: A single hand-set strand of noble metal, links smaller than a grain. Weighs more than it looks.

it_lux_chew_tin.name: Chew tin
it_lux_chew_tin.desc: A flat tin of nicotine pouches. One under the lip lasts a shift, and nobody sees it.

it_lux_cloth.name: Cloth
it_lux_cloth.desc: Plain woven bolt, undyed and a little stiff. Garments, bandages and banners start here.

it_lux_cosmetic.name: Cosmetic pot
it_lux_cosmetic.desc: Soot and fat, ground fine and sealed in glass. Darkens a lid, flushes a cheek.

it_lux_cup.name: Clay cup
it_lux_cup.desc: Fired grit, rough inside and plain outside. Holds a ration of anything.

it_lux_curtain.name: Curtain
it_lux_curtain.desc: Cloth hung on a polymer rail. Gives a bunk a door, and a body some privacy.

it_lux_cushion.name: Cushion
it_lux_cushion.desc: Cloth case stuffed with lint. Takes the shape of whoever sat on it last.

it_lux_dice.name: Dice
it_lux_dice.desc: Two cubes of polymer, the dots drilled by hand. One of them runs a little heavy.

it_lux_duct_caps.name: Duct caps
it_lux_duct_caps.desc: Small brown-capped mushrooms that grow where the ducts run damp. Eat two and the walls start breathing.

it_lux_gas_whip.name: Gas whip
it_lux_gas_whip.desc: A small steel cartridge of nitrous, meant for the galley's cream. A minute of giggling and a headache.

it_lux_gloves.name: Work gloves
it_lux_gloves.desc: Cloth palms lined with polymer. Stops a hot pipe from taking the skin off.

it_lux_lighter.name: Disposable lighter
it_lux_lighter.desc: Cheap plastic, every one a different colour. When it runs out, it is rubbish.

it_lux_lighter_fluid.name: Lighter fluid
it_lux_lighter_fluid.desc: A flask of thin, sweet-smelling solvent. Refills a zippo or feeds a lamp. Do not keep it near a vent.

it_lux_locket.name: Locket
it_lux_locket.desc: Gold, and the hinge still closes. What is inside was someone else's.

it_lux_matchbox.name: Matchbox
it_lux_matchbox.desc: Ten matches when new. The drawer shows how many are left.

it_lux_miners_leaf.name: Miner's leaf
it_lux_miners_leaf.desc: Bitter green leaves with a pinch of lime, chewed through a double shift. Green teeth, wide eyes.

it_lux_moonshine.name: Moonshine
it_lux_moonshine.desc: Algae mash run through a still nobody admits to. Cloudy, burns going down, cheap.

it_lux_music_box.name: Music box
it_lux_music_box.desc: A brass comb, a pinned drum and a hand crank. Plays one tune, slightly flat, and people go quiet.

it_lux_must.name: Wine must
it_lux_must.desc: Sweet cloudy mash in a flask, working slowly. It is wine if you leave it alone.

it_lux_oil_lamp.name: Oil lamp
it_lux_oil_lamp.desc: A glass chimney on a light-metal body with a braided wick. Burns oil, smells of it, and it gives a real flame.

it_lux_ornament.name: Gilt ornament
it_lux_ornament.desc: A printed polymer scroll with a skin of noble metal. The ring hangs these in corridors.

it_lux_overalls.name: Spine overalls
it_lux_overalls.desc: Heavy cloth, patched at the knees and fastened with salvage. Standard issue below the Mid Decks.

it_lux_pamphlet.name: Pamphlet
it_lux_pamphlet.desc: Two folded sheets, printed one side. Rules, rumours or a recipe, depending who wrote it.

it_lux_paper.name: Ream of paper
it_lux_paper.desc: Fifty sheets of fanfold paper, holes down both edges, in a kraft wrap. Drop it on a printer to load it.

it_lux_photograph.name: Old photograph
it_lux_photograph.desc: A printed face in a paper frame, silvered with age. Nobody alive can say who it is.

it_lux_pipe.name: Glass pipe
it_lux_pipe.desc: A hand-blown pipe swirled blue and amber, the bowl blackened. For leaf, resin, or whatever is going.

it_lux_print.name: Art print
it_lux_print.desc: Black ink on pressed paper, a view of a planet nobody on the station has stood on.

it_lux_printed_book.name: Printed book
it_lux_printed_book.desc: Machine-set pages in a board cover, the ink still sharp. Cheap enough to read, thin enough to lose.

it_lux_ring_coat.name: Ring coat
it_lux_ring_coat.desc: Long coat of real dense cloth, cut to hang straight. Nobody on the spine has ever worn one.

it_lux_ring_copper.name: Copper ring
it_lux_ring_copper.desc: A plain band cut from wire and joined. Turns the finger green in a week.

it_lux_ring_snow.name: Ring snow
it_lux_ring_snow.desc: A tiny vial of fine white powder, a silver spoon on the cap. Ring parties end at breakfast for it.

it_lux_rug.name: Woven rug
it_lux_rug.desc: Strips of old rag woven tight into a mat. Every one has a pattern nobody planned.

it_lux_scarf.name: Scarf
it_lux_scarf.desc: A long knitted strip of yarn and cloth, grey on grey. Warm round the neck in a cold duct.

it_lux_scent.name: Scent vial
it_lux_scent.desc: Spirit, petal oil and glass in a vial the size of a thumb. One drop lasts a shift.

it_lux_sculpture.name: Polymer sculpture
it_lux_sculpture.desc: A figure printed layer by layer from a model, the layer lines left in. Heavy for its size.

it_lux_signet.name: Signet ring
it_lux_signet.desc: Heavy gold and copper, flat face left blank for a name. Engrave it and it belongs to one person.

it_lux_smokes.name: Hydro smokes
it_lux_smokes.desc: A crushed soft pack of twenty, hydro-grown leaf. Lit in a vent, the smoke detector taped over.

it_lux_soap.name: Soap bar
it_lux_soap.desc: Grey fat boiled with salts and cut square. Smells of nothing, and gets the grease off.

it_lux_spice.name: Spacer spice
it_lux_spice.desc: Dry herb sprayed with something from a lab nobody runs. Cheap, strong, and nobody knows what is in it.

it_lux_spirit.name: Spirit bottle
it_lux_spirit.desc: Clear and fierce, run twice through the still. Sold sealed, with a company stamp on the cap.

it_lux_striker.name: Flint striker
it_lux_striker.desc: A bar of iron and rare earth with a steel scraper. Throws sparks into tinder on the first stroke.

it_lux_tray_leaf.name: Tray leaf
it_lux_tray_leaf.desc: A twist of sticky green buds grown in a hydro tray under a borrowed lamp. Smells like a greenhouse on fire.

it_lux_vape.name: Vapour pen
it_lux_vape.desc: Company-licensed: no flame, no smoke, a sweet cloud and a little red light. The Hub's answer to the smokes.

it_lux_vase.name: Glazed vase
it_lux_vase.desc: Kiln-fired and glazed green. Real flowers would look right in it, if there were any.

it_lux_wash.name: Sugar wash
it_lux_wash.desc: Sugar and grey water gone sour in a flask. Sharp, thin, and only good for the still.

it_lux_watch.name: Wristwatch
it_lux_watch.desc: Wound movement in a steel case. It runs eleven minutes slow and nobody would change that.

it_lux_wick.name: Wick
it_lux_wick.desc: A braided thread of yarn, stiff with use. A candle or a lamp is no good without one.

it_lux_wine.name: Wine bottle
it_lux_wine.desc: Dark green glass, no year on it. Hold it to the light to see how much is left.

it_lux_wooden_bowl.name: Wooden bowl
it_lux_wooden_bowl.desc: Real wood, turned by hand: you can feel the grain under your thumb. Smells faintly of a forest.

it_lux_wooden_horse.name: Wooden horse
it_lux_wooden_horse.desc: Carved from a single piece of real wood and worn smooth by hands. Wheels long gone.

it_lux_yarn.name: Spun yarn
it_lux_yarn.desc: A hank of fibre twisted tight on the bench. Weave it, knit it or braid it into a wick.

it_lux_zippo.name: Refillable lighter
it_lux_zippo.desc: Brushed chrome, a lid that clicks. Fill it with lamp oil or spirit.

it_mach_air_filter.name: Air cartridge
it_mach_air_filter.desc: A flat carbon-packed cartridge with a fibre pre-screen. Slots into a scrubber; bunks clip them over the vent.

it_mach_air_filter_spent.name: Spent air cartridge
it_mach_air_filter_spent.desc: The carbon bed is black and full. It rattles when shaken. Rinse it, or send it to the recycler.

it_mach_cleaning_kit.name: Cleaning kit
it_mach_cleaning_kit.desc: A rag, a brush and a vial of solvent in a pouch. Lifts dust and gum from the works of a machine.

it_mach_coolant.name: Coolant
it_mach_coolant.desc: Pale blue fluid in a ribbed flask. Poured on a hot machine, it takes the heat and the fault with it.

it_mach_drive_belt.name: Drive belt
it_mach_drive_belt.desc: A loop of ribbed polymer woven with fibre. Every drum and roller on the station turns on one of these.

it_mach_fuse.name: Fuse
it_mach_fuse.desc: A glass tube with a thin copper filament, packed in grit. It dies first so the machine does not.

it_mach_jam_kit.name: Jam kit
it_mach_jam_kit.desc: A roll of picks, a bent probe and a squeeze of grease. Frees a clogged feed without a wrench.

it_mach_label_roll.name: Label roll
it_mach_label_roll.desc: A roll of gummed paper strips, blank, with a hole for the labeller spindle.

it_mach_lubricant.name: Lubricant
it_mach_lubricant.desc: A squeeze tube of clear grease, smelling of oil and warm plastic. A little keeps a feed from jamming.

it_mach_manual.name: Service manual
it_mach_manual.desc: Forty printed pages of exploded drawings and torque figures, grease-thumbed. Read it before opening anything.

it_mach_padding.name: Padding
it_mach_padding.desc: Shredded rag packed in a flat bag. Stuffed round the goods it keeps a box from arriving dented.

it_mach_sealant.name: Sealant
it_mach_sealant.desc: Grey putty in a squeeze tube. Smeared over a seam it sets hard and holds water and gas.

it_mach_tape.name: Sealing tape
it_mach_tape.desc: A reel of grey polymer tape with a hard adhesive. A box sealed with it opens only under a knife.

it_mach_water_filter.name: Water filter
it_mach_water_filter.desc: A grey carbon-and-mesh cartridge in a polymer sleeve. The purifier runs through it; it clogs slowly.

it_mach_water_filter_spent.name: Spent water filter
it_mach_water_filter_spent.desc: A clogged cartridge, heavy and brown with trapped grime. Rinse it with clean water, or recycle it.

it_med_acid.name: Acid flask
it_med_acid.desc: Etched glass flask of reagent and salts, stopper waxed shut. Burns skin, clears scale.

it_med_antirad.name: Anti-radiation tab
it_med_antirad.desc: Chalky lithium tablet, taken before a shift near the core. It gives the dose somewhere to go.

it_med_antiseptic.name: Antiseptic
it_med_antiseptic.desc: A dropper bottle. Clean a wound before it turns.

it_med_antiviral.name: Antiviral
it_med_antiviral.desc: Pale green tablet with rare earth in the binder. Ring clinics stock it by the tray, the spine by the single.

it_med_bandage.name: Bandage
it_med_bandage.desc: A roll of gauze and a clip.

it_med_base.name: Base flask
it_med_base.desc: Flask of reagent cooked with carbon ash. Slick lye, handled with the clip tongs.

it_med_black_resin.name: Black resin
it_med_black_resin.desc: A sticky black lump in wax paper, from poppies somebody grows on the ring. Warm, slow, hard to stop.

it_med_blister.name: Blister card
it_med_blister.desc: Empty foil card of six pockets. Pills push out through the back and do not go back in.

it_med_blotter.name: Blotter
it_med_blotter.desc: A square of paper printed with a tiny eye, cut into tabs. One on the tongue and the station is very far away.

it_med_blue_ampoule.name: Blue ampoule
it_med_blue_ampoule.desc: Sealed glass ampoule of blue solution. Snap, swallow, and the station goes quiet for an hour.

it_med_burn_gel.name: Burn gel
it_med_burn_gel.desc: Cool clear gel in a squeeze tube, oil and reagent. Goes on scalds and weld burns.

it_med_burn_tab.name: Burn tab
it_med_burn_tab.desc: Grey tablet of carbon and reagent. Eases scald and weld flash pain for a few hours.

it_med_calmer.name: Calmer
it_med_calmer.desc: Salty white tablet that unwinds the jaw. Ends a stim early; the crash is spared, the day is not.

it_med_cough_syrup.name: Cough syrup
it_med_cough_syrup.desc: Thick purple syrup, codeine and sugar. For a cough, officially; mixed with soda, for a slow night.

it_med_crank.name: Crank
it_med_crank.desc: Cloudy crystal shards in a twist of foil, cooked behind the Works. Three days awake, then the bill.

it_med_desk_strips.name: Desk strips
it_med_desk_strips.desc: Company-issue focus strips in a blue sleeve: one on the tongue and a shift of spreadsheets goes by in an hour.

it_med_dock_candy.name: Dock candy
it_med_dock_candy.desc: A chalky pastel pill stamped with a rocket. On the dock floor everybody loves everybody till morning.

it_med_dream_tab.name: Dream tab
it_med_dream_tab.desc: Unmarked white tablet with a soft sweet taste. A warm, loose day in a body that is owed none.

it_med_energy_tab.name: Energy tab
it_med_energy_tab.desc: Sugar and a pinch of reagent pressed into a sweet tablet. A small lift, no hangover.

it_med_ethanol.name: Ethanol
it_med_ethanol.desc: Clear lab spirit in a stoppered vial. Wipes wounds, fuels lighters, and is drunk by the desperate.

it_med_fb_antibiotic.name: Antibiotic blister
it_med_fb_antibiotic.desc: Six pills in a foil card. They only come out.

it_med_fb_antirad.name: Anti-rad blister
it_med_fb_antirad.desc: Six chalky tablets in foil. Core crews buy them by the strip.

it_med_fb_antiviral.name: Antiviral blister
it_med_fb_antiviral.desc: Six pale green tablets in foil. Ring pharmacy stamp on the back.

it_med_fb_burn_tab.name: Burn tab blister
it_med_fb_burn_tab.desc: Six grey tablets in foil. Works crews carry one in the overalls.

it_med_fb_dream_tab.name: Dream blister
it_med_fb_dream_tab.desc: Six unmarked tablets in plain foil. No stamp, no maker, no questions.

it_med_fb_painkiller.name: Painkiller blister
it_med_fb_painkiller.desc: Six pills in a foil card. They only come out.

it_med_fb_sleeping_pill.name: Sleeping pill blister
it_med_fb_sleeping_pill.desc: Six pills in a foil card. They only come out.

it_med_first_aid_kit.name: First-aid kit
it_med_first_aid_kit.desc: Tub with a clip lid: two bandages and a bottle of antiseptic. Bolted to a wall in every decent corridor.

it_med_gauze.name: Gauze pad
it_med_gauze.desc: Square of loose-woven gauze, folded twice. Sterile until the packet is opened.

it_med_gene_patch.name: Gene patch
it_med_gene_patch.desc: Square skin patch of cultured cells and noble-metal contacts. One patch rewrites what the ring cannot cure.

it_med_pack_burn.name: Burn pack
it_med_pack_burn.desc: Tub of two gel tubes and two cards of burn tabs, labelled for the foundry deck. Cold-stored if there is room.

it_med_pack_ward.name: Ward pack
it_med_pack_ward.desc: Taped crate of painkiller and antibiotic cards, packed for a clinic ward. Ships as one line on the manifest.

it_med_pack_wound.name: Wound pack
it_med_pack_wound.desc: Sealed tub of four bandages and two bottles of antiseptic. The standing order of every works clinic.

it_med_painwash.name: Painwash
it_med_painwash.desc: A yellow morphine auto-injector, black safety cap. Clinic stock, numbered, and always going missing.

it_med_reagent_pure.name: Purified reagent
it_med_reagent_pure.desc: Clear reagent decanted off its sediment into a sealed vial. Pharmacy grade, or near enough.

it_med_regrowth_gel.name: Regrowth gel
it_med_regrowth_gel.desc: Faintly warm gel in a lined tube, seeded with rare earth. Closes a deep wound in days, not weeks.

it_med_rehydration_mix.name: Rehydration mix
it_med_rehydration_mix.desc: Sachet of sugar and salt to stir into a pouch of water. Ends the shakes after a bad vent shift.

it_med_saline_drip.name: Saline drip
it_med_saline_drip.desc: Soft bag of sterile saline with a line and a clamp. Clinics hang them, the spine hoards them.

it_med_solvent.name: Solvent
it_med_solvent.desc: Sharp-smelling spirit thinned with gas and bottled. Strips paint, dissolves resin, never indoors.

it_med_splint.name: Splint
it_med_splint.desc: Light-alloy strip with a padded lining and two straps. Holds a broken arm straight.

it_med_stim.name: Stim
it_med_stim.desc: Orange tablet, bitter. A shift of borrowed energy, repaid with interest the next morning.

it_med_suture_kit.name: Suture kit
it_med_suture_kit.desc: Curved needle, a hank of waxed thread and a sealed wipe. For a cut that will not close on its own.

it_tech_alarm.name: Door alarm
it_tech_alarm.desc: A sensor and a siren in a white shell. It shouts when the door opens and again when its cell dies.

it_tech_cable.name: Cable
it_tech_cable.desc: Sheathed cable, a metre of copper inside grey polymer. Joins everything to everything else.

it_tech_case.name: Device case
it_tech_case.desc: A printed polymer shell, layer lines still showing, with a light-metal core. Fits a handheld or a set.

it_tech_cell_l.name: Heavy cell
it_tech_cell_l.desc: A forearm of sealed lithium in a light-metal jacket. It runs a press or a mainframe, and weighs like one.

it_tech_cell_m.name: Cell
it_tech_cell_m.desc: Ribbed steel case, a charge gauge scratched into the side. Fuels the mid-size machines for a day.

it_tech_cell_s.name: Coal
it_tech_cell_s.desc: A lump of hard coal. In a furnace, a good while of heat; in a stove, an evening.

it_tech_chip.name: Chip
it_tech_chip.desc: A processor in a black package, legs bent from the tray. The reason rare earths are worth carrying.

it_tech_circuit.name: Circuit board
it_tech_circuit.desc: Green board, hand-soldered, flux still tacky. Every device on the station starts from one.

it_tech_clock.name: Wall clock
it_tech_clock.desc: A round face behind a pane, one hand missing. Ticks to station time, which is not the same as day.

it_tech_desk_unit.name: Desk unit
it_tech_desk_unit.desc: A ring desk machine in light-metal and gold trim. Silent, fast and mostly for show.

it_tech_dongle.name: Dongle
it_tech_dongle.desc: A hardware key the size of a thumb. Plug it in the port bay: licensed software asks for its serial.

it_tech_door_lock.name: Door lock
it_tech_door_lock.desc: A bolt on a relay with a keypad and two fobs. It opens to the right number and sulks at the wrong one.

it_tech_drone.name: Service drone
it_tech_drone.desc: A flat rotor frame on a sensor eye. It crawls ducts, reports leaks and cannot manage stairs.

it_tech_fan.name: Fan
it_tech_fan.desc: A grille, a motor and three blades. Moves foul air about and makes a bunk feel bigger.

it_tech_fob.name: Key fob
it_tech_fob.desc: A printed polymer tag with a metal core and a hole for a ring. Opens one lock and one only.

it_tech_gamepad.name: Gamepad
it_tech_gamepad.desc: A grey polymer pad with a cross of keys and a lead that plugs into the terminal's port bay.

it_tech_handbook.name: Handbook
it_tech_handbook.desc: Twenty stapled pages of exploded drawings and warnings. Packed with every device that needs explaining.

it_tech_handheld.name: Game handheld
it_tech_handheld.desc: A grey brick with a small screen and a cross of keys. It stacks blocks. Everyone loses a day to it.

it_tech_handset.name: Handset
it_tech_handset.desc: A cradle phone with a keypad and a tinny line to the next bunk. The spine rings it for news.

it_tech_hearing_aid.name: Hearing aid
it_tech_hearing_aid.desc: A polymer bud with a microphone and a cell sealed inside. The clinic fits them, the spine sells them on.

it_tech_heater.name: Room heater
it_tech_heater.desc: A bar of hot wire behind a grille. Warms a bunk, dries a coat, and drinks cells like water.

it_tech_keypad.name: Keypad
it_tech_keypad.desc: Twelve polymer keys on a switch mat, the numbers worn off the five.

it_tech_lamp.name: Grow lamp
it_tech_lamp.desc: Hydro light: a glass tube on a copper base. A tool, and it dims a little every night it burns.

it_tech_laptop.name: Laptop terminal
it_tech_laptop.desc: A folding terminal with a green screen and a cell slot. Small enough for a bunk, slow enough to forgive.

it_tech_loader_arm.name: Loader arm
it_tech_loader_arm.desc: A jointed arm on bearings that lifts a crate in one stroke. Bolts above a dock lane.

it_tech_memory_module.name: Memory module
it_tech_memory_module.desc: A strip of black chips on a green board. Doubles what a terminal can hold in mind.

it_tech_modem_card.name: Modem card
it_tech_modem_card.desc: A card with a line jack and a tiny speaker for the handshake. The terminal's way to the mail.

it_tech_motor.name: Motor
it_tech_motor.desc: Small electric motor: a copper winding round an iron rotor, and a hum. Fans, belts and loaders turn on it.

it_tech_notice.name: Notice poster
it_tech_notice.desc: Hard print, one colour: RATIONS AT SIX, KEEP THE DUCT CLEAR. Pinned up in every spine corridor.

it_tech_radio_set.name: Radio set
it_tech_radio_set.desc: A portable set with a telescopic whip. Hums with music, rumour and the company's hourly notice.

it_tech_relay.name: Relay
it_tech_relay.desc: A coil wound round a sprung blade in a clear case. Turns a whisper into a thump.

it_tech_screen.name: Screen
it_tech_screen.desc: A green phosphor screen in a cracked polymer frame. Text swims in it for a second after you look away.

it_tech_sensor.name: Sensor
it_tech_sensor.desc: Reads gas, heat or light through a pinhole of glass. Scanners and scrubbers listen to it.

it_tech_slip.name: Order slip
it_tech_slip.desc: Printed by the terminal for one order. Pack it in the box with the goods: a box without its slip does not ship.

it_tech_soldering_iron.name: Soldering iron
it_tech_soldering_iron.desc: A copper tip in a polymer grip on a coiled lead. Joins boards, and wakes dead handsets.

it_tech_speaker.name: Speaker
it_tech_speaker.desc: A paper cone and a rare-earth magnet in a polymer ring. It crackles by design.

it_tech_switch.name: Switch
it_tech_switch.desc: A thumb switch: brass blade, polymer rocker, two screws. It clicks like a lock.

it_tech_torch.name: Torch
it_tech_torch.desc: A polymer tube, a switch and a lamp: the legal light, no flame. In your hand at night it opens the dark places. Wears a little every night out.

it_tech_work_light.name: Work light
it_tech_work_light.desc: A caged lamp on a clamp with two metres of cable. Throws a hard white pool on the bench.

mach_algae_tank.name: Algae tank
mach_algae_tank.desc: A tall glass tank of green water with a lamp rack and an air stone. Grows biomass and breathes out.

mach_annealer.name: Annealer
mach_annealer.desc: A drum furnace with a quench tank and a timer. Heated and cooled by the book, tools last longer.

mach_assembler.name: Assembler
mach_assembler.desc: A cage of jointed arms over a jig. Boards, chips and housings snap together into whole devices.

mach_autofab.name: Autofab
mach_autofab.desc: A hall-length fabricator with a robot arm, a parts silo and a conveyor. Any blueprint, batches overnight.

mach_bench.name: Workbench
mach_bench.desc: A steel bench with a vice, a roller and a rack of hand tools. Repair, refill, bundle, refurbish.

mach_bioreactor.name: Bioreactor
mach_bioreactor.desc: A glass-lined tank the height of the deck, with spargers and a sample port. Sludge in, culture food out.

mach_broadcaster.name: Broadcaster
mach_broadcaster.desc: A rack transmitter with a feed encoder and a disc tray. Pushes your ad onto the deck screens.

mach_cell_press.name: Cell press
mach_cell_press.desc: A hydraulic press with a clean sleeve. Lithium, metal and reagent are squeezed into charged cells.

mach_cellar.name: Cellar
mach_cellar.desc: A cold insulated cabinet with a rack of shelves and a slow fan. Cheese and wine improve if you leave them.

mach_charger.name: Charger
mach_charger.desc: A wall-fed cradle that trickles station power into a spent cell. Billed by the charge, at the power price.

mach_chem_bench.name: Chem bench
mach_chem_bench.desc: A fume-stained steel bench with burettes, a hot ring and a rack of vials. Reagents, solvents, coolant.

mach_chiller.name: Chiller
mach_chiller.desc: A finned radiator box with a pump and two hoses. Pulls heat out of whatever it stands beside.

mach_copier.name: Disc copier
mach_copier.desc: A twin-drive disc cradle with a bar of green lights. Reads one disc, writes another, and does not ask.

mach_crusher.name: Crusher
mach_crusher.desc: Twin toothed rollers over a steel hopper. Breaks mixed scrap, e-waste and ice into sorted lumps.

mach_digester.name: Digester
mach_digester.desc: A sealed iron tun with a stirrer and a vent line. Sludge sours and settles into paste over nights.

mach_electrolyser.name: Electrolyser
mach_electrolyser.desc: Twin steel plates in a clear-glass tank, wired to a heavy rectifier. Water splits into gas.

mach_extruder.name: Extruder
mach_extruder.desc: A heated barrel and a die plate. Polymer flake goes in the top and sheet, tube or film comes out.

mach_fab_precision.name: Precision fabricator
mach_fab_precision.desc: A closed cabinet with a granite bed and a probe arm. Tight tolerances: bearings, valves, machine parts.

mach_fabricator.name: Fabricator
mach_fabricator.desc: A gantry with a feed hopper and a heated bed. A blueprint disc tells it what to make from bar and polymer.

mach_hydro_rack.name: Hydro rack
mach_hydro_rack.desc: Four tiers of trays under strip lamps, with a drip line down one side. Fruit, herbs and fibre crops.

mach_hydro_tray.name: Hydro tray
mach_hydro_tray.desc: A shallow polymer tray with a drip line and a lamp bracket. Seed, water and light turn over nights to crops.

mach_jeweller.name: Jeweller's bench
mach_jeweller.desc: A fine bench under a loupe lamp, with a micro torch, a jig and a lock-drawer. Noble metal stays here.

mach_kiln.name: Kiln
mach_kiln.desc: A brick drum on cells with a thick lid. Grit and slag fuse into glass, vials and ceramic.

mach_kitchen.name: Galley
mach_kitchen.desc: A hot plate, a pan well and a fan on cells. No flame, no smoke, and a pot of something warm.

mach_labeller.name: Labeller
mach_labeller.desc: A hand-fed gummer with a disc-driven print head. Sticks a grade or a licence on whatever you slide through.

mach_loom.name: Loom
mach_loom.desc: A wide loom rebuilt in light alloy, with a heddle drive. Fibre goes in; cloth and gauze come off.

mach_mainframe.name: Mainframe
mach_mainframe.desc: A cabinet bank behind a locked cage, humming and warm. Runs every machine on the field and the market clients.

mach_modem.name: Modem
mach_modem.desc: A beige box with a handset cradle and a line jack. Plugs into the terminal: no modem, no mail.

mach_pill_press.name: Pill press
mach_pill_press.desc: A turret press with a hopper of powder and a tray of dies. A hundred small thumps a minute.

mach_printer_3d.name: 3D printer
mach_printer_3d.desc: A glass-hooded gantry that lays polymer and light metal in threads. It reads its models off a memory card.

mach_printer_l.name: Banner printer
mach_printer_l.desc: A wide roller press on legs, with four ink wells and a take-up spool. Banners, art prints, ad sheets.

mach_printer_m.name: Document printer
mach_printer_m.desc: A flat-bed press with an ink well and a paper tray. Manuals, posters and books, a sheet at a time.

mach_printer_s.name: Dot-matrix printer
mach_printer_s.desc: A beige printer with a tractor feed, loud and slow and never wrong. Drop it on a computer to plug it in; drop a ream on it to load paper.

mach_pulper.name: Pulper
mach_pulper.desc: A tub with a paddle and a screen. Rags and lint soak into slurry and press out as paper.

mach_purifier.name: Purifier
mach_purifier.desc: A tall tank with a pump and a filter sleeve. Greywater or melted ice goes in, clean water comes out.

mach_radio.name: Radio
mach_radio.desc: A scuffed engineers' set tuned to the maintenance bands. Chatter about breakdowns before they happen.

mach_recycler.name: Recycler
mach_recycler.desc: A grinding drum and a row of sorting chutes. Anything in, materials out, a tenth to sludge.

mach_refinery.name: Refinery
mach_refinery.desc: A column of crucibles and cold traps, chimney bolted to the hull. Pulls rare earths and noble metal from slag.

mach_scanner.name: Scanner
mach_scanner.desc: A flat bed under a hooded lamp, wired to a sensor head. Shows what a box or a disc is hiding.

mach_scrubber.name: Scrubber
mach_scrubber.desc: A fan box with a slot for an air cartridge. Pulls foul air through carbon; the cartridge does the work.

mach_sealer.name: Box sealer
mach_sealer.desc: A clamp frame with a tape head and a hot wire. Run a packed box through and it comes out sealed.

mach_smelter.name: Furnace
mach_smelter.desc: A squat cast-iron furnace with a firebrick crucible. Coal in the firebox, a match to it, and two lumps of ore come out one bar.

mach_still.name: Still
mach_still.desc: A copper pot, a coil and a drip jar. Ferments and distils slowly, and smells of both.

mach_synthesiser.name: Synthesiser
mach_synthesiser.desc: A cabinet of reaction coils, cold traps and gas bottles. Builds molecules to order from a card.

mach_terminal.name: Wired terminal
mach_terminal.desc: An all-in-one machine with a curved green screen and a drive for floppy discs. It needs the wall socket to do anything at all.

mach_terminal_pro.name: Workstation
mach_terminal_pro.desc: A tower with a tall green screen, twin drives and a bay of ports. Bigger memory, more devices, scripts.

mach_vat.name: Vat
mach_vat.desc: A square steel vat with a paddle and a press head. Biomass paste goes in; a disc decides what comes out.

mach_vat_industrial.name: Industrial vat
mach_vat_industrial.desc: A riveted cauldron the size of a bunk with a screw press. Big batches, gourmet discs, overnight runs.

mach_vent.name: Vent port
mach_vent.desc: A hatch on a rail with a bolted collar. Sludge and waste go through for a fee and do not come back.
